title: Smoky Sweet Potato Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired stir fry featuring sweet potatoes, smoked vegetables, and a hint of Kenyan spices.

ingredients.name: Kenyan spices (such as curry powder and turmeric)

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and smoked vegetables, stir-frying until they start to soften.
Add the Kenyan spices and stir to combine.
Add the sliced sweet potatoes and stir-fry for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Continue to stir-fry for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
